children: RNS Number : 8539U  Polar Capital Global Financials Tst  15 September 2026
Polar Capital Global Financials Trust Plc
The Board has declared an interim dividend of 2.57p per Ordinary share payable to Shareholders on the register as at 2 October 2026 in respect of the year ending 30 November 2026.
The shares will trade ex-dividend from 1 October 2026 and the dividend will be paid on 29 October 2026 in line with the Company's dividend policy.
